status: Preparatory research completed. Design hypothesis awaits trace-level causal validation.
central_hypothesis: Maintain one provenance-aware, incrementally updated representation of requirements, candidate evidence, unresolved questions, world changes and procedural obligations. All shopping decisions consume that representation.
reasoning: Binary success couples request satisfaction, hidden-needs discovery, changing conditions, procedure, optimality and accepted termination. Local improvements can fail to change the final score when other obligations still fail.
At most one failure category is exposed. Treat the category as a starting point for reading the entire trace, without inferring it is the sole defect.
Every question or tool call consumes finite resources and may reveal a change. Information acquisition and purchase decisions must use the same current requirements.
Expensive repeated interpretation can both consume budget and produce inconsistent decisions. Evidence reuse could improve cost and consistency together, subject to measurement.
An unknown requirement or missing product attribute needs an explicit unresolved state. Treating all uncertainty as rejection can produce incorrect declines.
Customer requirements and listing facts have different authority. Product availability changes must be scoped to affected entities and invalidate dependent conclusions.
Category alternatives require preserving logical structure and shared constraints. A broader search must retain the shopper's actual acceptable alternatives.
Optimality is evaluated among acceptable choices. Search coverage and evidence completeness are distinct from the attractiveness of the currently selected item.

documented_constraints.contract: Synchronous agent_main, supplied dynamic tool schemas, whole opaque binding, sequential steps, stop on finished. Same-step same-action retry is replayed.
documented_constraints.budgets: Question and step budgets from task input. Published default network limits 300 seconds per task and 1800 seconds per sandbox run. OpenRouter scoped key cap 2 USD qualifying and 5 USD race per run, one-hour expiry.
documented_constraints.admission: UTF-8 Python up to 1 MB. Syntax parsing is one check. Security, integrity and structural originality checks also apply. Analysis must finish in 30 seconds.
documented_constraints.integrity: Derive shopping fields and values at runtime. Prohibitions include suite content, stored identifiers or answers, fixed unit/attribute tables, copied grader logic, ambient phase/validator routing and spending-cap evasion.
documented_constraints.comparison: Practice and qualifying are separate worlds. Same runtime does not establish score comparability. Overall leadership uses difficulty-adjusted recent race results.

documentation_caveats: Current guides specify OpenRouter only. Legacy credential endpoints and some default examples retain Chutes.
Current guides say check_summary and reward_summary are null. Generic endpoint schema examples still show populated objects.
Architecture says pack hashes stay internal, while the seed-commitment endpoint documents release of the world pack hash after reveal. Treat endpoint-specific release semantics separately.
FAQ describes daily close at noon PT while historical changelog equates this with 19:00 UTC. Use live qualifying_closes_at for scheduling.
Historical ShoppingBench reasoning coefficients and seven-family ORO Bench launch descriptions predate the October 22 world-based binary scoring update.
Local-testing prose saying the agent writes inside sandbox conflicts with the explicit code-requirements ban on agent file writes. Harness-owned output recording is the supported contract.
